dataset_kind: synthetic challenge set; not a representative real-camera validation dataset
prediction_target: Number of physical people visibly present in one camera image. Exclude depictions on posters/screens. Count partially occluded people when a distinct head/person is visible.
label_method: Two independent visual inspections of generated pixels agreed before any generated-scene model predictions. Labels are visual annotations, not prompt-requested counts.
leakage_audit: No training or threshold selection on these images. Pretrained weights stay fixed. Scenes generated after the pretrained checkpoint; original training contents unavailable, so broader contamination is not proven absent. Camera-size variants are paired views of the same scene, never independent samples.
